title: On the potential lack of response in a model of second-harmonic generation. A computer-assisted proof
summary: This paper provides a rigorous computer-assisted proof of the existence of generalized transmission eigenvalues arising in nonlinear optics in the context of high-order harmonic generation, a result conjectured in Cakoni, Hovsepyan, Lassas, and Vogelius, SIAM J. Math. Anal. 57 (2025), 1370-1405. The analysis is carried out for a one-dimensional nonlinear medium, where the problem reduces to a coupled system of nonlinear homogeneous ordinary differential equations subject to nonstandard boundary conditions.
